intent: Report the revenue attributed to the top artist group and its share of industry revenue.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Report the revenue attributed to the top artist group
Report the top artist group's share of industry revenue

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: The top 1% of artists generated $43 billion in music revenue.
accept: Displays or reports $43 billion as the revenue for the top 1% of artists
Center label reads $43b for the top artist group
reject: Reports a different revenue amount for the top artist group

units.claim: The top 1% of artists account for 30% of industry music revenue.
accept: Displays or reports 30% as the share of industry revenue for the top 1% of artists
Partial ring shows 0.3 of the whole for the top artist group
reject: Reports a different share for the top artist group
Omits the share of industry revenue

optional_valid: Labeling the ring segment as 'top 1% of artists' to bind the share to its entity
unsupported_to_avoid: Deriving or reporting the complement (70%) as a separate required fact
Adding other artist groups or sectors not present in the table
Reporting absolute industry revenue total not given in the table
review_notes: Single-row partial ring: the center label supplies the absolute revenue (center_count) and the ring arc supplies the share (share_of_whole).
No complement is required because the intent asks only for the top group's revenue and share.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
